name_zh: 敦克爾克撤退（發電機行動）

sources.citation: L.F. Ellis, The War in France and Flanders 1939–1940 (HMSO, 1953), ch. 16
sources.quote: When the operation ended 338,226 had been evacuated—308,888 of them in the ships under Admiral Ramsay's orders.

phases.name_zh: 發電機行動啟動與走廊作戰
phases.summary_zh: 5月26日晚下令發動發電機行動，英國遠征軍沿狹窄走廊且戰且退，法軍於27日夜放棄格拉沃利訥退守馬爾迪克—斯皮凱—貝爾格運河線，比利時軍於午夜停火。

sources.citation: L.F. Ellis, The War in France and Flanders 1939–1940 (HMSO, 1953), ch. 12
sources.quote: By the following Sunday evening, when Operation Dynamo was ordered ...

sources.citation: L.F. Ellis, The War in France and Flanders 1939–1940 (HMSO, 1953), ch. 12
sources.quote: By midnight on May the 27th the King of the Belgians had accepted defeat and the Belgian Army had been ordered to cease fire.

sources.citation: L.F. Ellis, The War in France and Flanders 1939–1940 (HMSO, 1953), ch. 12
sources.quote: During the night they withdrew from Gravelines and the Aa and occupied a line which followed canals from Mardick through Spycker to Bergues.

phases.name_zh: 比軍投降後撤入灘頭陣地
phases.summary_zh: 比軍投降後東翼洞開，德軍28日上午抵達紐波特一帶周界並奪得一座橋，英軍各師於29至30日陸續撤入敦克爾克周界。

sources.citation: L.F. Ellis, The War in France and Flanders 1939–1940 (HMSO, 1953), ch. 13
sources.quote: CHAPTER XIII AFTER THE BELGIAN SURRENDER 28th May, 1940

phases.summary_zh: 英軍第1軍守西半、第2軍守東半周界，德軍31日猛攻紐波特、弗爾訥與 Bulskamp，當夜英軍放棄比利時境內東段。

phases.name_zh: 縮小周界與英軍最後撤離
phases.summary_zh: 周界縮至法國國界與貝爾格—弗爾訥運河，德軍1日主攻貝爾格與 Hoymille，英軍後衛守至1日午夜後撤往海灘，6月3日凌晨英軍撤離完畢。

phases.name_zh: 法軍後衛與敦克爾克陷落
phases.fronts_note: 6月3日法軍最後防線走向於 Ellis 未見具體描述，待查證
phases.summary_zh: 法軍後衛掩護最後兩夜撤退，6月4日上午9時餘部投降，下午2時23分海軍部宣告發電機行動結束，共撤出338,226人。
